title: Concept: Predictable randomness via rand (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, rand is a statistical generator, not a cryptographic one: observing outputs reveals the state, and default seeds repeat across runs. Security values need unpredictability, which only SecureRandom provides in ruby.
applicability: ruby codebases drawing random values through rand; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Guessed session tokens, reset links, and nonces when predictable output guards access; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when the value directly authenticates.
